name: Vegetable Couscous
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: 1 carrot, 1 zucchini and 1 small bell pepper, diced
½ tsp each cumin and paprika
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Add the spices and vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the chickpeas and cook for 2 minutes.
Place the couscous in a bowl and pour over the hot stock. Cover and rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and fold in the vegetables.
Finish with lemon juice, salt and parsley.
note: Whole-wheat couscous cooks in minutes and has more fibre than regular.
